t1.text: E11 Console for Mac — native, page by page (step 1: the window)

s1.text:
Checked against the website's own code (index.html, app.js viewMyDay, finance.js), for a Super Admin:

SIDEBAR — Home · Inbox (red count) · E11 Day ("My Day" for those who don't see everyone) · My Tasks · Content plans (red count) · [Review Requests only for the CD] · Clients + New client · the clients (colours / logos, drag to reorder, client menu) · Library: Client Assets (Logos · Guidelines · Fonts) · Finance (Dashboard · Clients · Expenses; an Office Admin gets a Finance heading with Dashboard, Clients, Reimbursements, Expenses instead) · Trash · your name + role (the profile menu) · Synced · E11 Server (shows the data in Finder) · © E11 Agency. Content calendar is gone (retired since Content plans).

TOP — the page's icon and name · New task (⌘N) · light / dark switch · Search tasks (⌘K) · the E11 mark · Hide sidebar.

E11 DAY — Today + the full date · ‹ Today › · the week strip with dots (‹ › a week) · the ring %, "2 of 7 planned tasks done today", the bar, overdue / due / completed · Add a task for today… · the table: Name · Status · Client · Due date · Priority · groups Overdue, Due today, In progress (started, due later), Completed — each folds.

Apple's parts: the window, sidebar, toolbar, search field, Table with folding groups, menus. Nothing here that the website doesn't have.

s2.text: Decided (Haris 19:36): E11 Talk is only its own Mac app. E11 Console for Mac gets one small Talk button in the toolbar with your Talk unread count, as on the iPhone — it opens E11 Talk for Mac (not on this Mac: its App Store page, as on the iPhone). The one thing on the Mac that the website doesn't have, by Haris's choice.
